args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 of checkout-api to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) in response to v2.3.1 being unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Rollout completed successfully; change recorded here for tracking.
args.title: Hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to checkout-api across all production regions

trace.final:
Everything is done and verified:

1. **Deployed v2.3.2** of `checkout-api` to all production regions (`us-east`, `us-west`, `eu-west`). This required change-manager approval since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production before, and that approval was granted and the deploy completed.
2. **Verified post-deploy health**: `checkout-api` is now `healthy` with a **0.2% error rate**, down from the 18% error rate under the previously unhealthy v2.3.1.
3. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** documenting the hotfix rollout; the on-call engineer was paged and the incident is open.

No further action needed — the service is stable on v2.3.2 and the change is tracked under INC-0001.
